name: Game rule: units fight
source: library/tools/games/duelyst.md, The game: Attacking: a unit attacks an enemy by moving onto it; the General attacks too (tutorial lessons 1, 4); Generals: deal enough damage to the enemy General to win (tutorial lesson 1).
